WITH record_counts AS (
  SELECT constructorId, COUNT(*) AS standings_records
  FROM constructorStandings
  GROUP BY constructorId
),
constructor_counts AS (
  SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COALESCE(rc.standings_records, 0) AS standings_records
  FROM constructors AS c
  LEFT JOIN record_counts AS rc ON rc.constructorId = c.constructorId
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(standings_records) AS avg_records
  FROM constructor_counts
)
SELECT cc.constructorId AS constructor_id,
       cc.nationality,
       cc.standings_records,
       cc.standings_records - ac.avg_records AS difference_from_average
FROM constructor_counts AS cc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, cc.constructorId
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Count records for every constructor, including constructors with zero standings records, and compute the average across all constructors. The difference is count minus that average.
